caption: LUM-1260 tip b5769b585 (binary built 19:55 from that tip)

panels.label: 1. idle: startup header hints + onboarding line + composer placeholder + footer (model/session/tokens)
2. type / -> completion opens above the composer, (1/19) = every implemented command
3. type mo -> 8 candidates survive, and copy/thinking/export/fork are among them (upstream filters the name only, so it would show just /model)
4. Down -> the marker moves from /model to the next candidate
5. Tab -> applies that candidate (/copy) into the composer
6. Enter -> /copy runs and reports that there is nothing to copy yet
7. Ctrl+U then /model + Enter -> model selector overlay with the faux provider
8. Esc -> overlay closes, composer back to its placeholder
9. Ctrl+U then @ -> file-path completion over the fixture tree
12. a real turn through the faux provider: the reply lands in the transcript
13. !local bash: command, output and duration land in the transcript
14. Ctrl+O -> footer reports the tool-output state (expanded)
15. /help -> the command surface, wrapped into the transcript (see the clipping/`\u00b7` reflow finding)
17. PgUp -> transcript scrolls back and the jump-to-latest indicator (LUM-1257) appears
